objective: Expand in-app BUKLOD Kingdom with seven original pilot games using three shared, deterministic gameplay engines: Quin Guessing Quest, Van Mind Challenge, Mitch Color Merge, Angel Treasure Merge, Vhen Farm Merge, Trudice Word Garden, Niel Word Explorer; preserve 13 original stations, existing games, premium map, economy and production native runtime.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: reconciled GitHub source with latest main. R9 added game source without overwriting any main Word/KL/OTA workflow files; original Kingdom Map blob 88a4b1b4a70fc4acd59579419058b47f21be2554 preserved. This source proof is not proof of installed staging-user APK nor physical Android acceptance; no OTA is being published.
chosenApproach: Add evidence-riddle, power-of-two merge, and word-connect pure engines each with themed bilingual RN interfaces and full start/pause/result/replay flows; reuse unchanged station routes and account-scoped local preview. Overlay source onto latest main with zero path collisions and no native/OTA changes.
selectionRationale: Seven distinct character-themed titles implemented using three reusable, rule-verified engines rather than arbitrary placeholders; each has genuine puzzle input, deterministic outcome, score and offline play. Does not claim final premium original audio/asset packs or server reward grants.
alternativeApproaches: Replace all 13 station games with a monolithic new engine and downloadable binaries; rejected due to regression, startup size, security and APK compatibility risks.
Deploy 39 separate web applications; rejected as an initial solution due to inconsistent Android ad/audio/offline experiences and large integration burden.
Selected: shared Kingdom game platform with incremental playable interior games and strict no-economy pilot records.
